name: maestro-career-studio
description: Tailor resumes and track applications, from your own machine
long_description: Drive Maestro Career Studio from Claude: capture and score jobs, tailor resumes against a job description, render PDFs, and track applications. Requires Maestro Career Studio running on this computer. AI features send content to the model provider you configure in the app.

backend_url.title: Maestro address
backend_url.description: Where Maestro Career Studio is running. Change it only if you moved the backend port.

profile.title: Tool profile
profile.description: full (88 tools) or a scoped set: hunt, apply, explore, templates, career. Enable one at a time — the scoped profiles are subsets of full, so more than one costs context without adding capability.
